attach.why: Stage s4 and the final-delta formula of nhl.coach_expectation_delta: supplies the joint simulation of every team's remaining regular season (final points, correlated across coaches) from which each coach's simulated final delta is computed; it is the canonical simulator and replaces the DUPLICATE-flagged nhl.team_season_points_distribution, which this archetype no longer carries.

The roster-change term inside the in-house preseason expectation P_exp of nhl.coach_expectation_delta (minutes-weighted impact of arrivals minus departures, age curve) comes from this blend of last seasons' ratings with current-season data; used in stage s2 only to fix the expectation a coach is judged against before opening night.
